finding: Prenatal and peripartum antibiotic use along with CS delivery were associated with differences in the diversity and composition of the meconium microbiome.
mod_finding: Cesarean section (vs. vaginal delivery) was associated with greater alpha diversity of the meconium microbiome and lower relative abundance of the genus Escherichia.
